content: An official hermes-agent skill (version v1.0.0) is the authoritative source for all Hermes Agent configuration and operational tasks, containing verified native commands (e.g. `hermes config set`, `hermes tools`, `hermes setup`) for managing CLI, config, models, providers, tools, skills and other Hermes components; agents should reference this skill instead of inventing custom workarounds for Hermes-related requests.
